layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Theropod lacrimal horn morphology
features: A close-up of a theropod's eye and brow area
A sharp, triangular clay hornlet sitting just above and in front of the eye
The horn has a different texture than the skin, looking slightly more fibrous or polished like a clay tool
The skin around the eye is detailed with deep clay 'fingerprint' textures and fine scales
A vibrant splash of red or blue clay on the horn to suggest its use as a display feature
layer_3_action.action: A dramatic macro shot of the 'eyebrow' horn. The lighting is focused on the horn's texture and color, leaving the rest of the face in soft shadow. This serves as a 'Lacrimal Horn' morphology icon. No text.
